name: Coding agent tokens
question: Are coding agents doing more work?
metric: Tokens used by the coding apps OpenRouter ranks, latest full month
solvedIf: Coding agents do most of the work
trendLabel: Tokens used by ranked coding apps on OpenRouter per month, in trillions.
caution: Tools like Cursor and direct use of AI labs may not appear here, so this undercounts agent use.
The list of ranked apps grew over time, and more tokens can mean less efficient work rather than more of it.
rule: Growing when ranked coding apps use more tokens than in the same month a year before.
scoreReason: 227 times the tokens of January 2025, against a goal of 1,000 times.
